name: g2-check
description: step G2 books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit; springs; duplication 0.3 / loss 0.1 a birth, null / off / on toggled at runtime, a resize with G (wild founders), key M off and on, turnover mode and back, a snapshot saved and loaded (300 s): atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'linker', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.3, 'ions', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 1e9); if (!moire.oases.started) moire.oases.start(); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)

const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 400); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'emulsion', 300); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.4, 'soap', 200); return 'springs again'

const c = await moire.dup.now(); return JSON.stringify({t: c.time, n: c.n, working: c.working, acting: c.acting, withCopy: c.withCopy, engCopy: c.engCopy, pumpCopy: c.pumpCopy, copies: c.copies, fate: c.fate, battery: c.battery, lineDups: c.lineDups, fam: {n: c.families.n, all: c.families.all, branched: c.families.branched, inCell: c.families.inCell, top: c.families.top}, pfam: {n: c.pumpFamilies.n, branched: c.pumpFamilies.branched, top: c.pumpFamilies.top}, rates: c.rates})
